description_sq:
Apartamenti ndodhet tek Kompleksi Halili,pozicionohet ne katin e dyte te nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor.
Organizohet nga nje ambient ndenje sebashku me kendin e gatimit,dy dhoma gjumi,nje tualet dhe nje ballkon.
Orientimi mjaft i favorshem lindje-perendim i mundeson ndricim natyral gjate dites.
Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
Per me teper informacion na kontaktoni.
description_en: The apartment is located in the Halili Complex, on the second floor of a new building with an elevator. It is organized by a living room with a kitchenette, two bedrooms, a bathroom and a balcony. The very favorable east-west orientation enables natural lighting during the day. The property has regular mortgage documentation. For more information, contact us.
